morphology.habit: Rhizomatous perennial herb to 1.2 m, angular stems
morphology.leaves: Lower opposite to subopposite, upper mostly alternate, mid-stem lanceolate/oblanceolate to narrow elliptic with cuneate base and membranous green blade
morphology.flowers: Spike-like flowering stem, purple petals 3–6 mm, stamens usually 6(–8)

records.diagnostics: Green, wedge-based lanceolate middle leaves instead of narrower glaucous blunt-based leaves of L. californicum
